decisions.interpretation: The uniquely routed original podium matches its stable government CSUID/BuildingID, source GeoRef/subtype and complete GeoRef cell. Current provider OBJECTIDs differ from cached viewer keys; both revisions and all measured footprint changes are explicitly retained. No exact current-provider OBJECTID claim is made. ROOT inspected complete source plans/obliques and every saved original junction. The sole foreign footprint overlap is the narrow authored adjoining exterior wall/roof-edge boundary with the other exact podium in this pair. Accept only this exact source association; preserve all original facets and raw overlap/contact evidence. This is not common ownership, a duplicate-suppression instruction or a clearance/support/collision/terrain/publication waiver. Four-world contact differences, including Float32 area contacts, remain physical follow-up.
